The consistent scores across the three paths, all set at 0.621, suggest a strong and reliable relationship, likely mediated through the Protein-arginine deiminase type-1 enzyme. The mechanisms appear to involve the enzymatic activity of Protein-arginine deiminase type-1, which may modify the target compounds to alter their interaction with the phosphatase subunit. The evidence supports a plausible pathway where Osw-1 indirectly influences the phosphatase subunit through its interaction with these compounds, though further experimental validation would be necessary to confirm the direct involvement of Osw-1 in the regulation of the phosphatase subunit.
